description_en: Removes devices from an edge instance in batches
description_zh: 批量将设备从边缘实例中移除
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-unbind-device-from-edge-instance --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --iot-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUnbindDeviceFromEdgeInstance

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.
parameters.description_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.description_en:
The edge instance ID. In the [Link IoT Edge console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), on the **Edge Instances** page, hover over the target edge instance name to obtain the ID.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) operation to obtain the ID.
parameters.description_zh:
边缘实例ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。

parameters.description_en:
The list of device IDs. You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query information about all devices under the current account and obtain the IotId of each device.

> A maximum of 20 devices can be removed in a single call.
parameters.description_zh:
设备ID列表。可调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)查询当前账号下所有设备信息，获取设备IotId。

> 单次调用最多可移除20个设备。
